text: To the chiefe musition, a psalme (to be song) of the children of Corach. Clap your handes all ye people: make a noise vnto the Lorde with a ioyfull voyce.
For God is hygh and terrible: he is the great king vpon all the earth.
He wyll subdue the people vnder vs: and the nations vnder our feete.
He hath chosen for vs our inheritaunce: the glorie of Iacob who he loued. Selah.
The Lorde ascendeth in a triumph: and God with the sounde of a trumpet.
Syng psalmes to the Lorde, syng psalmes: syng psalmes to our kyng, sing psalmes.
For the Lorde is kyng of all the earth: syng psalmes all you that haue skyll.
God raigneth ouer the heathen: God sitteth vpon his holy throne.
The princes of the people are assembled together for to be the people of the God of Abraham: for the shieldes of the earth be Gods, who is hyghly exalted.
